appendixFigure.title: Recorded v5 result
appendixFigure.imageAlt: Mean child-minus-parent fitted-reward change is zero on dev and heldout; the strict positive heldout floor fails. Primary signed policy loss from inner epoch 2 by update, averaged per valid action. Exact restricted KL per valid action is 0.000123197, below its 0.8 ceiling.
appendixFigure.caption: Figure 1. Heldout mean child minus matched-parent fitted reward is 0.000 reward units across eight episodes and 29 valid actions; the predeclared strict positive improvement floor therefore fails. The second panel plots the primary lane’s signed clipped policy loss per valid action from the second inner optimizer epoch (epoch index 1), with update numbers 0 through 7; this is a training diagnostic rather than a quality score. Exact restricted conditional KL over eligible actions at sampled child-visited contexts is 0.000123197 per valid action, below the 0.8 ceiling; sampled selected-action KL is separately summarized in evaluation data. EOS and timeout arrays are synthetic zero-update probes, not model quality measurements.
